author: HotTheftAuto
quote:
The only thing better GTA V are the graphics. The gameplay mechanics and story are utterly trash compared to past titles. Repetitive and forgettable characters and story arcs.
Overly exaggerated realism parts with no real substance just to increase the time you spend in game, whilst forgetting GTA is an arcade game where gamers go to have fun and detach from the real life. Game feels like a chore list to complete with little to no reward
